Title: Information Security Policy
PolicyDescription: Defines employee responsibilities for protecting company information and systems. Covers data security best practices, password management, and incident reporting.

Title: Remote Work Policy
PolicyDescription: Explains expectations, eligibility, and security requirements for remote work. Includes guidelines for home office setup, working hours, and communication expectations.

Title: AI Usage Policy
PolicyDescription: Provides guidelines for responsible use of generative AI tools in the workplace. Covers approved tools, data handling restrictions, and quality review requirements.
AcknowledgementText: I confirm that I have read and understood the AI Usage Policy and agree to use AI tools responsibly.

Title: Data Handling and Classification Policy
PolicyDescription: Outlines how to classify, handle, and protect company and customer data. Defines data classification levels (Public, Internal, Confidential, Restricted) and handling procedures.

Title: Code of Conduct
PolicyDescription: Establishes ethical standards and expected behavior for all employees. Covers conflict of interest, harassment, diversity and inclusion, and gifts and entertainment.

Title: Acceptable Use Policy
PolicyDescription: Defines acceptable use of company IT resources including computers, networks, and software. Outlines prohibited activities and monitoring practices.

Title: Records Retention Policy
PolicyDescription: Specifies how long business records must be retained and guidelines for disposal. Covers email retention, document archiving, and legal hold procedures.

Title: Workplace Safety Procedures
PolicyDescription: Outlines safety procedures, emergency protocols, and workplace hazard reporting. Includes fire evacuation procedures, first aid, and incident reporting.

Title: Privacy Policy
PolicyDescription: Describes how the organization collects, uses, and protects personal data. Covers GDPR compliance, data subject rights, and breach notification procedures.

Title: Travel and Expense Policy
PolicyDescription: Guidelines for business travel, expense reporting, and reimbursement procedures. Covers airfare, hotels, meals, and approval workflows.
